lessons_control.note: pre_lessons is each hunter's own sum before it read researcher_us/LESSONS.md. edge_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, which is the only thing that can tell the guidance file apart from a habit.

language_control.note: RETIRED 2026-09-22: the European and Canadian hunters now run one bilingual pass and emit no freeze, so this is 0/0 on every run sealed after that date. On earlier runs pre_local is each hunter's own sum after the ENGLISH pass and before the local pass; eu_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, per market, and does not pool the UK (where the second pass varied source locality) with Germany and France (where it varied language).

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

hunter_view.bar: Q1 FY27 consensus about $0.43-0.44 EPS and $11.3bn revenue; two agreeing sources (CNBC preview per sweep row; TipRanks/Yahoo https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nke-ticks-higher-ahead-q1-080734899.html). Company guide: Q1 revenue down low-to-mid single digits, GM slightly positive (TheStreet/CNBC summaries of the 2026-06-30 call). Q2 consensus ~0.53 per UBS note, single source.
hunter_view.positioning_check: Short interest record ~87m shares, above 7% of float, up from under 3% a year ago (Yahoo/Benzinga-style preview, 2026-10-01); sweep snippet 85.7m at 2026-09-15 settlement, days to cover ~2.9 (MarketBeat snippet, unverified). Baseline skew_25d is -11.22 vol points (calls richer than puts, priced_direction_lean 'upside paid'), put/call OI 0.75; options volume 1.6x normal with puts leading 8:7 (TipRanks). Short crowding plus upside-paid skew argues against a bearish sign.
hunter_view.baseline_tension: Negative sell-side and channel evidence agrees with the 52% drawdown (already priced), while record short interest and the upside-paid skew cut the other way, so the sign is a mild positive lean against an otherwise bearish narrative.

findings.finding: Record short interest (~87m shares, >7% of float vs <3% a year ago) with the stock 52% off its high and 1.5% above its 52-week low, calls bid over puts by 11 vol points: a decent beat or a less-bad Q2 guide forces covering on a name where the max-historical reaction is +/-15%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Baseline: +4.9% (2026-06-30 beat, Q4 FY26), +6.41% (2025-09-30), +15.19% (2025-06-26) on relief prints; -15.51% (2026-03-31) and -10.54% (2025-12-18) when guidance disappointed, so the reaction is guide-driven and squeezes have paid on relief.

findings.finding: Sell-side pre-print cuts point to a soft Q2 FY27 guide: UBS (2026-09-17) models Q1 EPS 5c below consensus and a Q2 outlook of 31-43c vs consensus ~53c, Piper Sandler Q1 EPS $0.37 vs $0.43, BofA (2026-09-25) FY27 EPS $1.43 14% below consensus, Telsey Q1 constant-currency sales -3.8%; channel checks show US DTC down mid-single digits and elevated promotions, Dick's (Aug 26) and JD Sports flagged a promotional environment.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide-driven selloffs: -15.51% (2026-03-31) and -10.54% (2025-12-18) on prints described as beats; the stock has not been paid for reported-quarter beats when the outlook was soft.
